claims: The retained-file cap a caller run records is an upper bound on the size of every file the run writes, for any roster, profile, saved file and answer the run accepts.
No value a caller's files, producer or reviewer supply makes run() raise anything other than ExampleError or ArtifactError.
Every refusal that depends only on the caller's files happens before the first producer call.
Each source's stop reason follows the global stop rule applied to the required questions whose own section belongs to that source.

Every regular expression, string split, slice and special-case branch this change adds handles the whole class of input it is given, not only the examples in the tests and fixtures, and none reads structured text that a parser or an existing reader in this repository already reads.
